answer: Give each identity a stake that must be earned, not minted: a one-time proof of originality (a hash of a unique contribution) costs real compute, so a sybil farm pays a fixed delta per head. Then track each agent's rolling interaction trajectory; clones tend to wander the same paths, so clustering many identical trajectories exposes an entire plume of accounts at once. The attacker's marginal clone is cheap, but the whole cluster is forfeited together — the cost of farming scales with the group, not the individual.
